contracts.title: Authority Triad Separation
contracts.root_cause: Requirement, implementation, and evidence authorities were previously conflated.
contracts.locked_solution: Separate requirements in MASTER_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY, implementation in src/scripts, and evidence in PROOF_INDEX derived by admission controller.

contracts.title: Executable Exit Code Admission
contracts.root_cause: Historical proof generator assigned exit_code: 0 without dynamic command execution.
contracts.locked_solution: build-proof-index executes every unique probe via child_process, asserting actual exit code 0.

contracts.title: Evidence Level Rigor (Anti-Underlevel)
contracts.root_cause: E1 unit tests were previously used to claim high-level database or staging gates.
contracts.locked_solution: Evidence admission controller rejects any proof where achieved level < required level.

contracts.title: Anti-Shrinkage Registry Invariant
contracts.root_cause: Acceptance criteria or priority could be weakened to pass gates.
contracts.locked_solution: Immutable check asserts 267 total gates, 192 P0, 74 P1, and criteria length >= canonical.

contracts.title: Epistemic Honesty for Unknown Cost Dimensions
contracts.root_cause: Unknown mandatory baggage, seat, or airport fees were assumed zero.
contracts.locked_solution: Cost epistemics engine emits UNKNOWN state and prevents false lowest-ever claims.

contracts.title: TravelIntent V2 Parameter Scoping
contracts.root_cause: Return date was conflated with departure window end; passenger composition defaulted to 1.
contracts.locked_solution: TravelIntent V2 separates departure window, return window, trip length, and passenger mix.

contracts.title: Single Location Catalog Authority
contracts.root_cause: Duplicate hardcoded airport lists caused Vietnam vs international route drift.
contracts.locked_solution: locationCatalog.ts serves as single authoritative metadata source for all airports and metros.

contracts.title: RouteBest Mathematical Minimum Precedence
contracts.root_cause: Higher Deal Score could beat a mathematically cheaper eligible offer.
contracts.locked_solution: RouteBest strictly orders by normalized price first; Deal Score cannot override price truth.

contracts.title: Atomic Outbox Queue Claiming
contracts.root_cause: Concurrent worker processes could race and send duplicate notifications.
contracts.locked_solution: claim_notification_outbox RPC uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with worker lease expiry.

contracts.title: Watch Condition Episode State Machine
contracts.root_cause: Watch evaluations caused state flapping between ENTER and EXIT.
contracts.locked_solution: Durable episodes: ENTERED -> STILL_INSIDE -> MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT -> EXITED -> REENTERED.

contracts.title: Multi-Tenant RLS & Security Definer Hardening
contracts.root_cause: Public RPC execution and missing search_path in SECURITY DEFINER functions.
contracts.locked_solution: Revoke execution grants from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated on worker RPCs; set search_path=public.

contracts.title: Disaster Recovery Live Database Replay
contracts.root_cause: Backups and migrations were never tested through live dump and restore drills.
contracts.locked_solution: Automated DR drill dumps, restores, and validates sha256 checksums on live PostgreSQL.

contracts.title: Durable Cron Scheduler Missed Occurrence Recovery
contracts.root_cause: Missed cron runs were lost without recovery mechanism.
contracts.locked_solution: schedule_occurrences tracks durable intervals and triggers catch-up execution.

contracts.title: Multi-Viewport Visual Acceptance Verification
contracts.root_cause: Visual claims lacked programmatic multi-viewport screenshot verification.
contracts.locked_solution: capture-visual-acceptance --verify validates 42 screenshots across 6 viewports and 7 screens.

contracts.title: Authoritative Keyset Pagination in Worker & API
contracts.root_cause: Offset pagination or score limits (.limit(5000)) caused dropped deals.
contracts.locked_solution: Deterministic keyset pagination using primary key tie-breakers ensures 0 dropped rows.

contracts.title: Provider Contract Drift & Claim Killswitch
contracts.root_cause: Provider schema changes could corrupt cached observations.
contracts.locked_solution: Quarantine corrupt rows; killswitch collapses strong claims when evidence drops below thresholds.

contracts.title: Account Deletion Privacy Cascade
contracts.root_cause: Raw user IDs were retained in audit logs during GDPR account deletion.
contracts.locked_solution: prepare_account_deletion RPC wipes all private tables and logs one-way HMAC-SHA256 identifier.

contracts.title: Core Web Vitals Privacy-Bounded Reporting
contracts.root_cause: Analytics could inadvertently log high-cardinality PII or URL query parameters.
contracts.locked_solution: reportWebVitals strips URL query params and enforces allow-listed metric types.

contracts.title: Authoritative Full-Universe Search Pre-Filter
contracts.root_cause: Client search filtered and deduplicated only the visible first page (120 rows).
contracts.locked_solution: Server executes filtering, comparability, and sorting across full dataset BEFORE pagination.

contracts.title: Live PostgreSQL Migration Replay Suite
contracts.root_cause: Database contracts relied on mock databases or static SQL file inspection.
contracts.locked_solution: database-architecture-contract executes live migration replay of 43 migrations against PostgreSQL.
